[[Snakebite's Fang]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[sword]] obtained from [[Grahame]] in [[Lion's Arch Keep]] after completion of [[The Battle for Lion's Arch]] in exchange for 10 [[Medal of Honor|Medals of Honor]]. 

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 15-22 (Requires 9 [[Swordsmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while Health is above 50%)
:Lengthens [[Poison]] duration by 33%
:[[Health]] +30 

==Skin==
Has the same skin as a [[Sunqua Blade]].
